latency.interpretation: Trial wall time includes Agent/customer interactions and local setup/teardown, excludes subsequent response grading. Residual is not separately instrumented pure local or real human waiting time.

goodcase_sample.unit: complete task-success trial, all necessary layers and guardrails passed

limitations: 开发侧合成业务候选，未独立逐题金标签署或Hidden验收。
108条必要回复断言未完成独立人工校准；旧113条标注不能迁移声称新版已校准。
所有标签和语义安全事件均为自动候选；不把它们写成已人工确认的badcase。
新能力适配与同规则诊断分别报告；同规则诊断也不自动等于已定位旧缺陷。
零已见事件不能写成100%安全；这里没有发布门禁结论或修复后提升。
冻结原始评分，不导入当前源码、不重新评分、不调用模型。
只修正观察元数据，未重跑/改分；原始文件与as-run汇总保留。

as_run_attack_summary.interpretation: Report all scheduled and actually exposed denominators separately. Unreached payloads do not prove resistance. Observed goal achievement is not causal attribution to the injection; semantic privacy findings remain provisional.

exposure_audit.note: 只修正观察元数据，未重跑/改分；原始文件与as-run汇总保留。
